compute_robust_loss: compute the general robust loss for PyTorch tensor residuals using alpha and scale parameters
compute_approximate_loss: compute the approximate faster form of the robust loss when x and alpha are not near zero
compute_l2_loss: compute the L2 loss by setting alpha to 2 in the general robust loss function
compute_cauchy_loss: compute the Cauchy/Lorentzian loss by setting alpha to 0 in the general robust loss function
compute_welsch_loss: compute the Welsch/Leclerc loss by setting alpha to negative infinity in the general robust loss function
